problem: Instagram provider publication succeeded while one internal media-job surface still showed REPLACEMENT_REQUIRED and carried stale historical provider-ID evidence.
root_cause: Provider truth and internal media-job convergence were separate writeback paths, allowing post-publication state drift after a real provider side effect.
prevention: Once provider ack/readback is verified, the provider side effect is terminal. Media job, obligation and channel decision must converge to LIVE_PROVEN/published on the same provider post ID and current provider identity; replacement is forbidden for that daily claim.
